description: Get several places at once (like json_get for each, in order). One line per place: PATH, a TAB, then the value as one line of JSON (or the "[too big] ..." line, or "[error] CODE reason" for that place). The places are independent: one failing does not stop the others; if any failed the last line is "json_multi_get: error: PlacesFailed ...". Example: {"paths": ["cfg.json#/name", "cfg.json#/states/think/next"]}.

paths.description: the places, each FILE#/POINTER in one string (as in json_get); at least one

max_bytes.description: per place: print the value only if its one-line JSON is at most this many bytes (default: env AOS_JSON_MAX_BYTES, else 8000)

full.description: true = print every value however big
